Zellij web_sharing "off" (e21524b) only applies after a Zellij restart. On Mjolnir ~/.config/zellij is a directory symlink into the checkout, so a git pull there is enough before restarting.

~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.grok/config.toml and ~/.codex/config.toml are NOT stow-managed; only the status line and theme keys are upserted by bin/setup-agent-statusline.sh and theme-toggle. Never stow those directories whole.

Project layouts under zellij/.config/zellij/layouts/projects are git-ignored, so regenerating them on one host does not migrate the other host. There is no converter; migration is per-host --force regeneration using each file's // path: header.

Bootstrap's plain `stow ... scripts` can fold a missing ~/.local/bin (or ~/.local) into a repo symlink, after which the claude/codex/grok installers would write into the repo. On a new machine run mkdir -p ~/.local/bin first or stow with --no-folding. Codex/Grok status line keys need python3 >= 3.11 (tomllib).

repo_state.summary: S02 (review): bin/new-zellij-audit-layout.sh [--force] [--session <session>] <name> asks for the project count, each path and an optional label, and writes layouts/projects/<name>.kdl with '<label> Auditor', '<label> Provider' and two-pane '<label> other' tabs per project (cwd = that repo) plus a final 'Shell' tab at the projects' common parent (3N+1 tabs); answers can be piped; the session defaults to the layout name. S01 (review): fixed scripts/.local/bin/theme-toggle permission detection on GNU/BSD stat and explicit chmod/rename failure handling. Failed agent writes now return nonzero without a false success line; independent agent writes still run. Added eight isolated regression tests and per-slice verify/smoke runners. README documents an opt-in GNOME switcher hook; the system switcher and desktop preferences were not changed.

scripts/.local/bin/claude-remote-control sets only remoteControlAtStartup in ~/.claude/settings.json (on/off/toggle/default/status) so new Claude Code interactive sessions auto-connect or not. The settings file stays out of stow. Needs jq.

e21524b: zellij/.config/zellij/config.kdl sets web_sharing "off"; sessions are no longer shared through the web server unless a session opts in. Web server setup and per-host service flags are unchanged.

8c0480a: new agent-cli stow package (agent-cli/.claude/statusline.sh, agent-cli/.grok/statusline.sh). bin/setup-agent-statusline.sh stows it with --no-folding and upserts only the status line keys in ~/.claude/settings.json (.statusLine), ~/.grok/config.toml ([ui.status_line]) and ~/.codex/config.toml ([tui] status_line, status_line_use_colors), validated as JSON/TOML; --check mode is called by bin/check-health.sh. Both bootstrap scripts run it and now install jq (macOS also installs python for tomllib).

d773ca9: scripts/.local/bin/theme-toggle now also themes Claude Code, Codex and Grok, with an `auto` mode that puts Claude and Grok on follow-the-terminal themes (Codex is pinned to the current flavour). scripts/.local/bin/update-agents.sh (stowed to ~/.local/bin) updates Claude Code, Codex, Grok and Gemini only when a newer release exists and prints the current versions. zsh/.zshrc accepts interactive comments.

bin/new-zellij-project-layout.sh now generates single-pane claude, codex, and grok tabs; a code tab running nvim; and two-pane tools and shell tabs. README documents the layout. Existing local layouts require --force regeneration, and an existing named Zellij session must be deleted before the new layout structure appears.

New scripts stow package installs ~/.local/bin/theme-toggle (Catppuccin latte<->macchiato toggle for Alacritty + Zellij via live config reload, explicit flavours + status supported); both bootstrap scripts stow it; zellij config normalized to a single theme line; zshrc gained grok CLI PATH/completions block.
